$description.en_us: Data-driven Forging Blueprint definition from MiXianTu.
$description.zh_cn: 由觅仙途数据包加载的锻造目标与要求定义。

$description.en_us: One item and how many of it the input slots must hold.
$description.zh_cn: 一项物品及其在输入槽中需要的数量。

$description.en_us: Order-independent material requirement: the 15 input slots only have to hold at least the declared amount of every entry, from any slots. One to fifteen entries, and no item twice.
$description.zh_cn: 无序材料需求：15 格输入槽合计持有每项声明的数量即可，来自哪些槽位不限。1..15 项，同一物品不能重复出现。

$description.en_us: A forging method id this blueprint accepts.
$description.zh_cn: 本蓝图允许的一种锻打方式 ID。

$description.en_us: An explicit list of the method ids this blueprint accepts. An empty list - like omitting the field - restricts nothing, and then the placed tools alone decide. What may actually be struck is always this set intersected with the methods the tools unlock.
$description.zh_cn: 显式列出本蓝图允许的锻打方式 ID。空列表与省略该字段一样表示不做限制，此时完全由已放置的工具决定。实际可锻打的方法始终是此集合与工具解锁方式的交集。

$description.en_us: One method id, or one "#namespace:tag" that stands for every method in that tag. A tag that resolves to nothing allows nothing - unlike an empty list, which allows everything the tools unlock.
$description.zh_cn: 单个锻打方式 ID，或单个 "#命名空间:标签" 表示该标签下的全部方式。标签解析为空时什么都不允许 —— 这与空列表不同，空列表是允许工具解锁的全部方式。

$description.en_us: Which methods this blueprint accepts: a list, a single method id, one #tag, or nothing at all.
$description.zh_cn: 本蓝图允许的锻打方式：可以是列表、单个方式 ID、单个 #标签，或完全不写。

$description.en_us: Left end of the meter. Must be negative, so the bar always crosses zero. A strike that would leave the meter is refused.
$description.zh_cn: 数值条左端。必须为负数，保证数值条跨过 0。会让数值越界的锻打会被拒绝。

$description.en_us: Right end of the meter. Must be positive, so the bar always crosses zero.
$description.zh_cn: 数值条右端。必须为正数，保证数值条跨过 0。

$description.en_us: Lower end of the success band, inside the meter. The band is inclusive on both ends.
$description.zh_cn: 成功区间（闭区间）的下界，必须落在数值条范围内。

$description.en_us: Upper end of the success band, inside the meter and at or above the lower end.
$description.zh_cn: 成功区间（闭区间）的上界，必须落在数值条范围内且不低于下界。

$description.en_us: Optional closing rule. Omit it for a blueprint that only asks for a value.
$description.zh_cn: 可选的收尾规则。只要求数值的蓝图可以省略。

$description.en_us: The blueprint's only failure condition: reaching this many strikes without meeting the completion rule fails the forge. Omit it (or write 0) and the player may keep striking until the piece is done.
$description.zh_cn: 本蓝图唯一的失败来源：达到该步数仍未满足完成条件即判定失败。省略（或写 0）则玩家可以一直锻打到满足条件为止。

$description.en_us: One ascending step of the quality curve.
$description.zh_cn: 品质曲线中的一档，按额外步数升序排列。

$description.en_us: Ascending extra-steps-to-quality mapping; an empty list is rejected. The first entry whose max_extra_steps covers the run wins, so the last entry has to be 2147483647. Extra steps = actual steps - optimal steps.
$description.zh_cn: 额外步数到品质的升序映射。首个满足 max_extra_steps 的条目即为成品品质，因此最后一项必须是 2147483647。额外步数 = 实际步数 - 最优步数。

$description.en_us: Item produced by a successful forge.
$description.zh_cn: 锻造成功时产出的物品 ID。

$description.en_us: Action run on the striker when the forge completes. Defaults to nothing.
$description.zh_cn: 锻造成功时对发起者执行的行为，默认不执行。

$description.en_us: Action run on the striker when the forge fails or is cancelled. Defaults to nothing.
$description.zh_cn: 锻造失败或被取消时对发起者执行的行为，默认不执行。

$description.en_us: What a failed or cancelled forge gives back. Omitting it destroys the locked input.
$description.zh_cn: 锻造失败或取消时的返还规则。省略即销毁已锁定的材料。

$description.en_us: One entry of the order-independent material requirement.
$description.zh_cn: 无序材料需求中的一项。

$description.en_us: Item id the input slots have to hold.
$description.zh_cn: 输入槽必须持有的物品 ID。

$description.en_us: How many of that item are required, 1 to 64. Defaults to 1.
$description.zh_cn: 该物品需要的数量，范围 1..64，默认 1。

$description.en_us: The closing sequence, checked against the tail of the strike history. Only the last required_suffix_steps entries are compared; the positions in front of them are drawn as barriers and take no part in the rule.
$description.zh_cn: 收尾序列，与锻打历史的末尾比对。只有末 required_suffix_steps 项会被校验，前面的位置在界面上是屏障格，不参与判定。

$description.en_us: One of the six closing methods.
$description.zh_cn: 六个收尾锻打方式之一。

$description.en_us: Six method ids, or omitted when required_suffix_steps is 0. A non-zero requirement needs all six, and they must be methods this blueprint allows.
$description.zh_cn: 六个锻打方式 ID；required_suffix_steps 为 0 时可以省略。要求步数非 0 时必须写满六项，且必须是本蓝图允许的方式。

$description.en_us: How many of the last strikes must match the tail of steps, 0 to 6. Zero means no closing requirement.
$description.zh_cn: 末尾需要匹配的步数，范围 0..6。为 0 表示不要求收尾。
